chronology_honesty: S2.4R results were committed in a prior gate (HEAD 1568ae4) and are already observed. This rubric is constructed solely from independently-retrieved public-paper METHOD claims. The material-gap outcome is driven by an explicit METHOD mismatch (vis2img random vs index-aligned pairing), independent of the observed result magnitudes; no criterion was tuned to our numbers.
SUPPORTED_requires: A: no unresolved HIGH-materiality explicit method mismatch
B: core prediction concordant (above paper null, not merely r>0)
C: core dimensionality concordant if evaluable
D: core alignment concordant if evaluable
E: no result relies solely on a beta preparation contradicted by public evidence
PARTIAL: substantial method components match AND >=1 central result concordant, but >=1 central method/result mismatched/unevaluated/ambiguous
NOT_SUPPORTED: public method reconstructable AND implementation concordant AND central findings clearly fail (NOT merely because B1 -- a non-b2 branch -- is weak)
INSUFFICIENT: strongest verdict blocked primarily by missing public method info
MATERIAL_GAP_rule: If any HIGH-materiality explicit method mismatch means S2.4R is not yet a fair implementation of the public method, issue S2_5R_MATERIAL_METHOD_GAP_IDENTIFIED and do NOT force a reproduction status.
prediction_null_rule: r>0 must NOT be substituted for 'above shuffled null' unless a paper-compatible null is available.
alignment_rule: Do NOT substitute trial-correlation/Procrustes/principal-angles/centroid-corr for Roy's variance-projection alignment ratio.
